:::writing{id="74219" variant="email" subject="Invitation to Join the Luxora Collective Growth Engine"}
Hi Tracy,

I wanted to personally invite you to take a look at what we’ve officially built with the Luxora Collective Growth Engine.

This is the full operating system we use to support aesthetic brands that are ready to scale with intention, systems, and predictability, not just ads or one-off strategies.

I’d love for you to review the full list of deliverables on the site and then have a conversation around how the three-pillar framework works together in real life execution.

The Growth Engine is built on three core pillars:

Market Blueprint  
This is where we assess positioning, audience demand, competitive landscape, and revenue opportunities so decisions are rooted in market reality, not assumptions.

Acquisition Engine  
This includes paid media strategy and execution, funnel optimization, CRM implementation, automations, and AI-powered lead handling to drive consistent, qualified demand.

Revenue Multiplier  
This pillar focuses on increasing lifetime value through offer structure, memberships, retention strategy, follow-up systems, and ongoing optimization.

Everything is fully integrated. Ads, CRM, automations, reporting, AI updates, and ongoing system improvements are all handled under one roof so your brand can focus on growth, not managing vendors or tech.

As a founding partner and someone I deeply respect in this industry, I want to extend a 50% courtesy rate for the initial 90-day Growth Engine program.

After the 90 days, ongoing support would transition to $2,500 per month, which includes:
• Continued ad management and optimization  
• Full access to our CRM and automations  
• Ongoing AI integrations and platform upgrades  
• Funnel, messaging, and conversion improvements  
• Strategic oversight and performance tracking  

No long-term lock-ins, just a growth partnership built for momentum and scale.

Take a look at the deliverables here when you have a moment:  
www.theluxoracollective.co

If it feels aligned, I’d love to walk you through it together and explore how this could support your next phase of growth.

Always excited to build alongside you.

Warmly,  
Bethany
